name: J-Fall 2026
address: Pathé Ede, Laan der Verenigde Naties 150, 6716 JE Ede, The Netherlands
venueDescription: Pathé Ede is a large congress center and cinema in the center of the Netherlands. The largest room (Room 9) has 1027 seats; the foyers serve as the exhibition floor (Market floor).

programme.item: NLJUG Update and Masters of Java Award Ceremony

nearestPublicTransport: Train station Ede-Wageningen; from there bus 1, 2 or C3 (stop Stadspoort) or bus 6 (stop Gelderhorst), or the free J-Fall shuttle bus
travelFromCentralStation: From Ede-Wageningen railway station take the stairs or escalator up to Platform 1, turn right immediately and follow the 'Route Ede Centrum' signs. At the end of the path the J-Fall shuttle buses (J-Fall logo in the front window) wait on your right-hand side.
travelByCar: Take the A12 (direction Utrecht or Arnhem), exit 24 Wageningen/Ede/Bennekom, turn right at the traffic lights and follow the signs to Pathé Ede.
travelFromAirport: From Amsterdam Schiphol Airport take the train to Ede-Wageningen (via Utrecht Centraal), then the J-Fall shuttle bus or bus 1, 2, C3 or 6 to the venue
wifi: Free Wi-Fi for light use such as browsing and social media; not suitable for streaming or other high-bandwidth use

price.conference: Free for NLJUG members (J-Fall is for NLJUG members only); the conference is sold out
price.ticketSales: First batch opened September 24 at 12:00, second batch October 8 at 12:00. Key and Core NLJUG members receive a personal registration link on their date.
price.preconference: EUR 225.00 excl. VAT: pre-conference workshops on Wednesday November 11, 2026, 13:00-17:00 at Van der Valk Hotel Veenendaal
price.academiaDiscount: No student or academic discount is listed

preconference.description: Expert-level 4-hour workshops ahead of the main event

workshops.title: Asynchronous Programming in Java: From Callbacks, to Completable Futures, to Virtual Threads
Crafting your Agentic Harness: Hands-On Harness Engineering for AI Coding Agents
Taming Non-Determinism: From Probabilistic Testing to Resilience Patterns

inclusion: Name stickers show your preferred form of address, and there is a quiet, sensory-friendly silence room. D&I mentors are available via the Mentorship Hub.

nearbyAccommodationOptions.name: Van der Valk Hotel Veenendaal (pre-conference location, a short drive from Ede)

communityDrinks.name: J-Fall Network & Drinks
communityDrinks.description: The conference day closes with networking and drinks on the Market floor.
